lead_fa: Preservation یک هیلی آرام ولی پرقدرت است: با منابع دوگانهٔ Mana و Essence و کست‌های Empower بازی می‌کند؛ با [[Echo]] نصف ریید را آماده می‌کنی و با اسپل‌های پرقیمت مصرفش می‌کنی. دو مسیر Hero Tree داری: [[Flameshaper]] که در فصل 2 شفای بیشتری می‌دهد و [[Chronowarden]] با رَمپ‌های بزرگ‌تر و Tip the Scales دفاعی.

strengths: Empowered casts are very strong and available frequently
Decent damage contribution throughout fights and dungeons
weaknesses: Low range for a healer (30-yard), frustrating on some fights
Strong healing casts prefer a stacked group; healing drops when the group spreads

prominent: Season 2 empowers the Flameshaper hero tree and its abilities, and offers different healing strengths to talent into (stronger HoTs)
Dream Breath's heal-over-time effect greatly buffed in exchange for a smaller upfront heal

hero.recommendation: Flameshaper does more healing in Season 2, specializing in constant healing rather than only at the apex of a ramp. Chronowarden focuses on larger ramps hitting more targets and lets Tip the Scales serve as a prominent healing cooldown.
hero.flameshaper: Built around Dream Breath: greatly buffs it and grants an extra charge; explode Dream Breath buffs with Emerald Blossom and Verdant Embrace (including echoed forms) for more healing.
hero.chronowarden: Empowers Bronze spells and Verdant Embrace; classic Preservation ramp gameplay.

builds.codes_source: Wowhead 'Best Preservation Evoker Talent Builds' page (wowhead.com/guide/classes/evoker/preservation/talent-builds-pve-healer), export strings captured verbatim via the page's Copy buttons on 2026-10-27; do not modify.

concepts: Two key components: the Echo buffs you place and the spells you consume them with.
Cast Temporal Anomaly as often as possible; Dream Breath just after consuming your Echo buffs; they are expensive but justify their cost.
Set up Echo buffs across half the raid, then consume with high-value spells; drop Emerald Blossom for splash healing in between.

rotation.echo_mechanic: Echo and Temporal Anomaly place Echo buffs on allies; the next spell cast on any target consumes all Echo buffs and duplicates that spell to all of them. Example: five Echo buffs from Temporal Anomaly + Reversion gives all five targets a Reversion HoT.
rotation.raid_flow: Preservation builds short ramps: cast Dream Breath to generate Merithra's Blessing, place Echoes (Temporal Anomaly), then consume with Reversion / Verdant Embrace / Spiritbloom depending on the damage pattern.
rotation.cooldowns: Rewind is a powerful raid cooldown; Time Dilation and Tip the Scales (Chronowarden) are part of the defensive/healing toolkit. Pre-plan big cooldowns around damage phases.

gear.gearing_rules: Raid: Crit >= Mastery > Haste >> Versatility; Mythic+: Haste > Mastery = Crit >= Versatility. Intellect/ilvl still wins. The BiS picks up overvalue raid pieces (Awoken Dreadfang Cuirass, Aqirbane Reliquary); the last two raid bosses drop special 344 ilvl pieces 10 levels above anything else. Use QE Live for accuracy.

tier_set.name: Echo of Calamity
tier_set.pc2: Consuming Essence Burst sends forth a Living Flame at your target at 100% effectiveness (or a nearby injured target if they are full health).
tier_set.pc4: Green spells restore 5% more health, and Verdant Embrace has a 100% chance to grant Essence Burst.
tier_set.note: The 2pc is extremely powerful, adding incredible spot healing to all Echo and Emerald Blossom casts; the 4pc is less exciting but still worth equipping.

stats.cheatsheet: Raid: Crit >= Mastery > Haste >> Vers; M+: Haste > Mastery = Crit >= Vers
notes: Two different orders depending on content type.
Do not neglect Intellect: substantial ilvl increases generally win.
Use QE Live for the most accurate gearing.

tips: Temporal Anomaly on cooldown during the gather to preload Echoes.
Emerald Blossom splash plus Verdant Embrace mobility covers spread damage better than ramps.
